<a id="a-reserve-defers-the-end--储备推迟终结"></a>
# A reserve defers the end

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`reserve-defers-ending` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](reserve-defers-ending.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A reserve defers the end, which still comes: Dependent, activity only where supported, is the zero reserve; a reserve can be a held condition; and a decaying reserve bounds coextinction link by link along a chain of any length.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A reserve on a web is an amount for each formation that does not rise across a step at which the formation is unsupported, and falls if the formation is active there; the zero reserve is exactly Dependent, so relaxing ‘activity only where supported’ means allowing a positive reserve, not activity outside dependence. (`Becoming.Web.Carries`, `Becoming.Web.carries_zero`, `Becoming.Web.Dependent`)
2. A reserve can be a held condition: in a balanced flow, a condition nothing gives to at steps at which its holder is unsupported, and which is taken from, by whatever takes part, when the holder is active there, has its standing as the holder's reserve; where the holder itself takes part and takes from it, the reserve is the holder's own use, as a fox burns its fat. (`Becoming.Flow.carries_of_held`, `Becoming.Flow.carries_of_own`)
3. Where no held condition is represented, the reserve is supplied: no condition of the two seeds' webs carries them. (`Becoming.Seed.no_held`, `Becoming.Viable.no_held`)
4. An active formation whose dependences fail has a positive reserve, so where a held condition carries the formations, each unsupported dependence can be moved onto the held condition at need one, keeping levels, activity and drawing, and the web so read meets Dependent by construction: lag is dependence transformed onto the held condition. (`Becoming.Web.Carries.pos`, `Becoming.Web.redirect`, `Becoming.Web.redirect_dependent`, `Becoming.Famine.transformed_dependent`)
5. The two readings differ in which events undermine: the fox's event at step one undermines as published and not when its dependence is moved onto its fat, so the choice of reading bears on the stepwise valuation. (`Becoming.Famine.living_differs`)
6. A reserve defers the end and does not escape it: a formation unsupported from some step on is not active at arbitrarily late steps, and over any stretch is active at most as often as its reserve at the start (at most k with capacity k). (`Becoming.Web.Carries.active_not_recurring`, `Becoming.Web.Carries.lasts`, `Becoming.Web.Carries.lasts_within`)
7. So after a loss without return with the dependence unchanged, and after the end of an embodied relatum it depends on at a positive need, a formation is active beyond its support at most as often as its reserve: lagged ending and lagged coextinction; with the zero reserve they are ending when fixed and coextinction. (`Becoming.Web.Carries.consumed_lasts`, `Becoming.Web.Carries.coextinct_lasts`, `Becoming.Web.consumed_ends_when_fixed`, `Becoming.Web.coextinct`)
8. Dormancy defers in the same way: unsupported, a formation does not arise at arbitrarily late steps; where the reserve also decays while dormant (a seed's viability), dormancy is bounded in time as well: a formation unsupported from some step on is not active once as many steps have passed as its reserve. (`Becoming.Web.Carries.arising_not_recurring`, `Becoming.Web.Decays`, `Becoming.Web.Carries.ends_within`)
9. Where the reserve so decays, coextinction runs down a chain of dependence of any length link by link: in a chain of n links whose relata depended on are embodied, each depending at a positive need on the one before it from step T on, the first inactive from T, each relatum up to the nth is inactive once the reserves of the links before it, each read where the link before ended, have passed. (`Becoming.Web.Carries.chain_ends`, `Becoming.Web.chainEnd`)
10. With the zero reserve every link ends at T, coextinction at once; without decay, with excluded middle as a hypothesis, each relatum of the chain is still inactive from some step, with no bound. (`Becoming.Web.chainEnd_zero`, `Becoming.Web.Carries.chain_ends_of_em`)
11. A food chain is a finite chain; where dependences climb a bounded rank, as in every finite web without a cycle of dependence, no chain goes on without end, an unending chain being the case of every length. (`Becoming.Web.climbs`, `Becoming.Web.no_unending_chain`)
12. Without excluded middle that end step does not follow in general: if every formation never supported, with a carried reserve and decided activity, had a step after which it is never active, even one active at most once, the limited principle of omniscience would hold. (`Becoming.Web.lpo_of_ending`, `Becoming.Once.once`, `Becoming.LPO`)
13. Witnesses: a seed in the dark wakes twice on its reserve and never again, awake exactly as often as its reserve at the start, its reserve not decaying; a seed with a viability of three wakes at step 2 and never after, attaining the bound in time. (`Becoming.Seed.seed`, `Becoming.Seed.not_decays`, `Becoming.Viable.viable`)
14. A fox depending on the embodied hare outlives it by exactly two steps on its fat, a condition in the flow that the fox burns itself, and read with the fox's dependence moved onto the fat, with the same levels, activity, drawing and flow, it meets Dependent. (`Becoming.Famine.famine`)
15. In a chain in which each relatum depends at need one on the one before it, the bound along the chain is attained: each relatum outlives the one before it by exactly one step on its reserve, while without the reserve relatum 1 would be active unsupported; the same cascade cut to three relata has relatum 2 inactive from chainEnd 2 = 3 by the finite form, attaining the bound, while no unending chain runs through it. (`Becoming.Cascade.cascade`, `Becoming.short_cascade`)
16. Each law holds of every world in a local form: the reserve carries and decays only for the formation and at the steps used, the zero reserve at one step and formation being exactly being supported while active there, and the held condition balanced only at that step and condition; the global forms above are its corollaries. (`Becoming.Web.CarriesAcross`, `Becoming.Web.DecaysAcross`, `Becoming.Web.carries_zero_across`, `Becoming.Web.CarriesAcross.pos`, `Becoming.Web.active_not_recurring_from`, `Becoming.Web.CarriesAcross.step`, `Becoming.Web.lasts_on`, `Becoming.Web.arising_not_recurring_from`, `Becoming.Web.decays_by_from`, `Becoming.Web.ends_within_from`, `Becoming.Web.chain_ends_from`, `Becoming.Web.chain_ends_of_em_from`, `Becoming.Web.redirect_supported_at`, `Becoming.Flow.carriesAcross_of_held`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Carries, like Dependent, is a representational premise: which amount carries a formation, and that it does not rise while the formation is unsupported, are supplied by the application. Carries.lasts also needs whether the formation is active at each step to be decidable (a hypothesis of the theorem, not an axiom).
- Decays is a further representational premise, used only for ends_within and chain_ends: the reserve falls across every step at which the formation is unsupported and the reserve is positive, whether or not the formation is active.
- carries_of_held needs the flow to balance the web; nothing gives to the held condition at steps at which its holder is unsupported; at each step at which the holder is unsupported and active, the held condition is taken from by the formations taking part (not necessarily the holder; carries_of_own asks the holder itself to take part and take). Which condition a formation holds is supplied by the application.
- consumed_lasts uses a loss without return and an unchanged dependence (as consumed_ends_when_fixed); coextinct_lasts uses dependence at a positive need from the step at which the embodied relatum has ended, Embodied being read under the one-kind identification (see life-as-condition-of-life).
- Web.redirect and redirect_dependent need whether a formation is supported at each step to be decidable (a hypothesis of the theorem, not an axiom).
- chain_ends and chain_ends_of_em further use, for a chain of n links: the relata depended on (the first n) embodied; each of the n links depending at a positive need on the one before it from step T on (link by link, the premise of coextinct_lasts); and the first inactive from T.
- The conclusion holds of the relata up to the nth; an unending chain is the case of every n. chain_ends_of_em does not use Decays and takes excluded middle as a hypothesis, not an axiom.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- The conclusions bind a formation unsupported from some step on, not whether support returns: a reserve that bridges to returning support can carry activity without end.
- Under a carried reserve dormancy uses no reserve, and the time of dormancy is bounded only under the further premise that the reserve decays. Witness: `Becoming.Seed.not_decays`.
- Without decay a link's end step has no bound: excluded middle gives only that each link ends, and without it an end step implies omniscience (LPO) in general, so the core does not state it. Witness: `Becoming.Web.lpo_of_ending`.
- The bound along each finite chain reaching a relatum is given; the form taking the least bound over the chains of a graph is not stated.
- The transformed reading re-describes the reserve and is no further fact about the unfolding.
- The held-condition law counts any uptake by the formations taking part, not only the holder's.
- The two readings differ in which events are living, and which one is used is a correspondence premise.
- The witnesses are minimal.
- **Counterexample:** A seed in the dark fails Dependent and its reserve carries it: it arises twice and is never active again, awake exactly as often as its reserve at the start, so the bound is attained (Seed.seed). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Reserve.lean)
- **Counterexample:** A fox depending on the embodied hare fails Dependent; its fat, a condition in the flow, carries it, and it outlives the hare by exactly two steps, the fat's two units; read with the fox's dependence moved onto the fat, it meets Dependent (Famine.famine); the fox's event at step one undermines under one reading and not under the other (Famine.living_differs). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Reserve.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Without decay, dormancy is not bounded in time: Seed keeps its reserve while dormant (Seed.not_decays); a seed whose viability falls at every step wakes at step 2 and is inactive from step 3, attaining the bound of ends_within (Viable.viable). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Reserve.lean)
- **Counterexample:** A reserve need not be a held condition's standing: every level of the two seeds' webs is zero, no condition carries them, and the reserve is a supplied amount (Seed.no_held, Viable.no_held). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Reserve.lean)
- **Counterexample:** The bound along a chain is attained: relatum x is active through step x, relatum x + 1 depends on x at need one, and the reserve is one through step x; relatum k is still active at step k with chainEnd k equal to k + 1, and without the reserve relatum 1 is active unsupported at step one, failing Dependent (Cascade.cascade). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Reserve.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Turning ‘active only finitely often’ into an end step needs omniscience: a formation never supported, active at the first true of s, carried by its reserve, with decided activity holding at most once; if every such formation had an end step, LPO would hold (Web.lpo_of_ending, Once). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Reserve.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Uses decidability of the named determinations, a logical commitment written as a hypothesis.

<details><summary>Correspondence, dependencies, sources and history</summary>

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Since P6 the open programme has listed ‘relax Dependent (buffers, reserves, lag)’; coextinction's scope excluded seed banks, reserves and dormancy (life-as-condition-of-life); generation-is-replenishment's next step listed activity and standing out of step. Following the nondual method, where a flow and a held condition are represented, a reserve is not a new primitive: it is the standing of a condition the formation holds, buffer and lag are dependence on what is held, and they can be read as a transformation of dependence (P6's consumed_continues_transformed); where no held condition is represented, the reserve is a supplied amount (Seed, Viable). The two readings change which events are living, so where a held condition is represented, which reading is used is a correspondence premise bearing on the valuation. Deferring without escaping is the pattern of unceasing-generation-needs-renewal's ‘substitution defers the end without escaping it’ (substitution_defers, Relay), here deferring on a held condition. The physical content is that what is held is finite. Fat, seed banks and savings are examples of application, not content of the theorems. Along a chain of dependence, each reserve is read where the link before it ended, so replenishment while supported is counted in the bound and needs no further premise; with the zero reserve this is coextinct along a chain, across steps (P31).

### Dependencies

- **formal-reuse**: [becoming-dependence-dynamics](becoming-dependence-dynamics.md). Reuses Supported, Dependent and the outcomes of a loss; the zero reserve is exactly Dependent, and consumed_lasts generalizes consumed_ends_when_fixed.
  - Output: Activity only where supported; three outcomes of a loss.
  - Input: Activity can go beyond support, at most as often as what is held allows.
  - Preserved conditions: Carries; a loss without return with the dependence unchanged. [Dependence.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Dependence.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [becoming-renewal-reading](becoming-renewal-reading.md). Reuses falls_not_recurring: a reserve that never rises from some step on does not fall at arbitrarily late steps.
  - Output: An amount counted in whole units (natural-number amounts) that never rises from some step on does not fall at arbitrarily late steps.
  - Input: An unsupported formation is not active at arbitrarily late steps.
  - Preserved conditions: Carries; unsupported from some step on. [Renewal.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Renewal.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [life-as-condition-of-life](life-as-condition-of-life.md). Reuses Embodied; coextinct_lasts generalizes coextinct to formations with a reserve.
  - Output: An embodied relatum's ending ends every formation whose chain reaches it (under Dependent).
  - Input: With a reserve, a formation depending on it is active after its end at most as often as its reserve.
  - Preserved conditions: Embodied; dependence at a positive need; Carries. [Roles.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Roles.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [more-needs-renewers](more-needs-renewers.md). Reuses flows, balance, giving and taking; a reserve is the standing of a held condition in a flow.
  - Output: Balanced flows: a level changes by exactly what is taken and given.
  - Input: A held condition carries its holder.
  - Preserved conditions: Balance; no giving while unsupported; taking while active. [Flow.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Flow.lean)
- related, not a proved adapter: [generation-is-replenishment](generation-is-replenishment.md). The same module states standing beyond activity: a seed is given its standing while dormant (Provisioned), and waking needs nothing given (Sleeper).
- related, not a proved adapter: [unceasing-generation-needs-renewal](unceasing-generation-needs-renewal.md). Substitution defers the end without escaping it (substitution_defers): the same pattern.
